domain-information: As an archivist, I want to apply licenses or rights statements to files so that I know how they can be used.
As an archivist, I want to restrict individual or groups of files from view or by user/IP so that sensitive material is protected.
As an archivist, I want to set restriction end dates on files so that files become accessible automatically when appropriate.
As an archivist, I want to redact portions of files temporarily so that non-sensitive information can be shared safely.
As an archivist, I want to upload single or groups of files and automatically generate access copies so that file management is efficient.
As an archivist, I want to automatically create unique identifiers and embed metadata in files so that management and tracking are accurate.
As an archivist, I want to generate technical metadata for files so that I know file size, format, and other properties for preservation purposes.
As an archivist, I want to distinguish between files digitized for preservation and those for access so that I apply the right preservation actions.
As an archivist, I want to link electronic publications to citations so that research outputs are connected and discoverable.
As an archivist, I want to manage scans for research requests, educational use, or staff-generated materials so that they can be reused efficiently.
As an archivist, I want to track file usage and downloads so that I know which materials have been accessed.
As an archivist, I want to provide access to digital copies of unprocessed or donor-contributed materials so that authorized users can use them.
As a researcher, I want to search files by keyword, tags, structured data, or OCRed text so that I can find relevant materials across collections.
As a researcher, I want to view thumbnails, stream media, and preview excerpts so that I can select files for download or licensing.
As a researcher, I want to download files, request analog copies, or order reproductions so that I can use materials in publications or research.
As a researcher, I want accurate cross-collection citation data so that I can reference materials correctly and find them again.
As a researcher, I want to share links, reports, or files on social media or with staff so that research outputs are disseminated appropriately.
As a researcher, I want to understand the copyright status of files so that I comply with usage restrictions.
As a donor representative, I want to supply incremental accruals and access descriptive information or scanned images from my institution so that collections are kept up to date and usable.
As a donor representative, I want to view thumbnails and select images for use in exhibits or reports so that I can manage my institution's material.
As an archivist, I want to browse files in collections and view inventories or non-public finding aids so that I can provide research services efficiently.
As an archivist, I want to search images by photographer, subject, location, rights, or by uploading an image so that I can locate items without full metadata.
As an administrator, I want to create user groups, roles, and assign permissions or rights so that access to files and metadata is controlled appropriately.
As an administrator, I want to enable login via Active Directory and allow researchers to reset passwords so that account management is simplified.
As an administrator, I want to limit visibility of certain metadata fields by user group so that sensitive or internal information is protected.

domain objects.name: Archivist
domain objects.description: Manages, preserves, and provides access to archival materials.

domain objects.name: File
domain objects.description: Digital item in the archive containing content and metadata.

domain objects.name: Publication
domain objects.description: Published work referencing archival materials.

domain objects.name: Share Data
domain objects.description: Information or links for external file access.

domain objects.name: Copyright Status
domain objects.description: Legal ownership and usage rights of a file.

domain objects.name: Restriction End Date
domain objects.description: Date when a restricted file becomes public.

domain objects.name: License
domain objects.description: Defines how a file may be used or shared.

domain objects.name: Access Copy
domain objects.description: Lower-resolution version of a file for public access.

domain objects.name: Metadata
domain objects.description: Information describing and managing a file.

domain objects.name: File Identifier
domain objects.description: Unique ID assigned to a file.

domain objects.name: File Size
domain objects.description: Amount of digital storage a file occupies.

domain objects.name: File Format
domain objects.description: Technical format of the file, e.g. PDF, TIFF.

domain objects.name: Preservation Type
domain objects.description: Indicates if the file is for preservation or access.

domain objects.name: Citation
domain objects.description: Reference linking a publication to source materials.

domain objects.name: Researcher
domain objects.description: User accessing archival materials for study or publication.

domain objects.name: Research Request
domain objects.description: Request to locate or access materials.

domain objects.name: File Preview
domain objects.description: Simplified view of a file for browsing or discovery.

domain objects.name: Thumbnail
domain objects.description: Small image preview of a file.

domain objects.name: Streaming Media
domain objects.description: Playable preview of audio or video content.

domain objects.name: File Excerpt
domain objects.description: Short extract or snippet of file content.

domain objects.name: Download
domain objects.description: Process of obtaining the data of a publication copy

domain objects.name: Collection
domain objects.description: Group of related files organized by provenance or topic.

domain objects.name: Analog Copy
domain objects.description: Physical reproduction of a digital or original item.

domain objects.name: Reproduction
domain objects.description: Duplicate created for research or publication.

domain objects.name: Publication Request
domain objects.description: Request to use archival materials in a publication.

domain objects.name: Donor Institution
domain objects.description: Organization contributing materials to the archive.

domain objects.name: Donor Representative
domain objects.description: Person managing contributions for a donor institution.

domain objects.name: Incremental Accrual
domain objects.description: New materials added to an existing collection.

domain objects.name: Finding Aid
domain objects.description: Guide describing the contents of a collection.

domain objects.name: Image Search Request
domain objects.description: Search for images by specific criteria

domain objects.name: Photographer
domain objects.description: The individual or organization who captured the image

domain objects.name: Image Subject
domain objects.description: The main content, person, object, or scene depicted in the image

domain objects.name: Image Location
domain objects.description: The geographical place or setting where the image was captured

domain objects.name: Image Rights
domain objects.description: The legal permissions and restrictions governing how the image can be used

domain objects.name: Reference Image
domain objects.description: An example image used to find visually similar images in the search

domain objects.name: Administrator
domain objects.description: Manages users, permissions, and system settings.

domain objects.name: User Group
domain objects.description: Set of users sharing common access rights.

domain objects.name: User Role
domain objects.description: Defines user permissions and responsibilities.

domain objects.name: Access Permission
domain objects.description: Specifies what a user or group can do.
